title: Heartwood
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 48.55 Linked Discourses 48.55
  • 6. Sūkarakhatavagga 6. The Boar’s Cave

Sārasutta Heartwood

“Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci sāragandhā, lohitacandanaṁ tesaṁ aggamakkhāyati; “Of all kinds of fragrant heartwood, red sandalwood is said to be the best. evameva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, paññindriyaṁ tesaṁ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṁ—bodhāya. In the same way, the faculty of wisdom is said to be the best of the qualities on the side of awakening; that is, for becoming awakened.

Katame ca, bhikkhave, bodhipakkhiyā dhammā? And what are the qualities on the side of awakening? Saddhindriyaṁ, bhikkhave, bodhipakkhiyo dhammo, taṁ bodhāya saṁvattati. The faculties of faith, Vīriyindriyaṁ …pe… energy, satindriyaṁ …pe… mindfulness, samādhindriyaṁ …pe… immersion, paññindriyaṁ bodhipakkhiyo dhammo, taṁ bodhāya saṁvattati. and wisdom are qualities on the side of awakening, in that they lead to becoming awakened.

Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci sāragandhā, lohitacandanaṁ tesaṁ aggamakkhāyati; Of all kinds of fragrant heartwood, red sandalwood is said to be the best. evameva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, paññindriyaṁ tesaṁ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṁ—bodhāyā”ti. In the same way, the faculty of wisdom is said to be the best of the qualities on the side of awakening; that is, for becoming awakened.”

Pañcamaṁ.
